name: ImageViewer
description:
The Lightbox's viewer in the page instead of a dialog: the same pictures, zoom and pan,
rotate and flip, full screen, slideshow, thumbnails, details and actions. Its keys work
while focus is inside it. It fills a parent of definite height, and holds the Lightbox's
stage height in one that has none.
signature: ({ index: indexProp, defaultIndex, onIndexChange, className, "aria-label": label, images, ...options }: ImageViewerProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions for the current picture at the end of the footer: download, open the original.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The viewer's accessible name. Default "Image viewer".

props.name: autoHideChrome
props.description: Fades the title, thumbnails and toolbar after a moment without input while in full screen. Any input brings them back; nothing moves. Default true.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the viewer's root, for layout.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The first picture shown when uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: defaultInfoOpen
props.description: Whether the details panel starts open when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: index
props.description: The picture shown. Pair with `onIndexChange` to control it.

props.name: infoOpen
props.description: Whether the details panel is open. Pair with `onInfoOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ previous: string; next: string; zoomIn: string; zoomOut: string; fit: string; fitted: string; alreadyFitted: string; largest: string; position: (index: number, total: number) => string; shown: ({ index, total, alt }: { index: number; total: number; alt: string; }) => string; thumbnails: string; show: (alt: string) => string; viewer: string; actualSize: string; actualShort: string; rotateRight: string; rotateLeft: string; flipHorizontal: string; flipVertical: string; fullScreen: string; exitFullScreen: string; startSlideshow: string; stopSlideshow: string; slideshowStarted: string; slideshowStopped: string; slideshowStoppedOn: ({ index, total, alt }: { index: number; total: number; alt: string; }) => string; details: string; moreTools: string; unavailable: string; loadFailed: string; loadFailedNamed: (alt: string) => string; retry: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: The largest scale, as a multiple of actual size: no gesture, key or step goes past it. Default 4.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the zero-based index to show, from previous/next, ← →, a swipe, a thumbnail or the slideshow (wrapping at the ends).

props.name: onInfoOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next state when the Details button toggles the panel.

props.name: renderInfo
props.description: Details for the current picture: a description, metadata. Supplying it adds a Details button; the panel sits beside the stage, or under it in a narrow box.

props.name: slideshowInterval
props.description: Milliseconds each picture stays up in a slideshow, counted once it has loaded. Default 5000.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Show a strip of thumbnails under the picture when there are several. Default true.

props.name: tools
props.description: The tool groups to show. Default all of them; full screen also needs a browser that has it.

props.name: zoomSteps
props.description: Zoom steps after "fit", as multiples of the fitted width. + and − stop at each, at actual size and at `maxZoom`. Default 1.5, 2 and 3.
